nodes.label: Header with pulse and stats summary
Skip-gram word embeddings over stems
nodes.rationale: Word meaning learned directly from neighborhood of stems with negative sampling and frequency subsampling.

nodes.label: Bigram/trigram synapse model
nodes.rationale: Each new bigram/trigram transition counts as a 'synapse'; drives the synapse counter.

nodes.label: Attention + residual MLP neural head
nodes.rationale: Small attention over CTX=3 context, two tanh layers with residual connection, trained with negative sampling.

nodes.label: n-gram / neural mixture sampling
nodes.rationale: Mixture weight depends on whether trigram/bigram evidence exists (0.68/0.55/0.35); top-k sampling with repetition penalty.

nodes.label: Turkish crude stemming
nodes.rationale: Strip longest suffix first, keep stem at least 3 letters, so inflected forms share embeddings.

nodes.label: Quality gate (information pollution filter)
nodes.rationale: Rejects URLs, keyboard garbage, low-letter text and limits each sentence to 3 learns to avoid pollution.

nodes.label: Message->reply associative memory
nodes.rationale: Replies retrieved by centered, rarity-weighted sentence vectors above threshold ESIK=0.45; community votes adjust pair scores and retire bad replies.

nodes.label: Thumbs up/down reward feedback
nodes.rationale: Approved replies become legitimate training data; votes go through the shared pool so all clients converge.

nodes.label: IndexedDB/localStorage brain persistence
nodes.rationale: IndexedDB used to exceed localStorage's 5MB cap; localStorage as fallback; float arrays base64-encoded.

nodes.label: Global brain version reset
nodes.rationale: Admin bumps ayarlar/surum; all clients wipe local brain and retrain from pool, e.g. after banning a user.

nodes.label: Rooms with opt-in learning
nodes.rationale: Rooms only feed the shared pool when owner enables 'ogren'; Ilker never learns from its own replies or closed rooms.

nodes.label: On-device training from shared sentence pool
nodes.rationale: Every client replays cumleler pool (last MAXCUMLE=8000) and trains locally; cursor IMLEC enables incremental sync.

hyperedges.label: Community feedback loop via shared pool
